technique_name: Explain how technology can help with energy conservation.
description: Technology is increasingly used to help reduce energy consumption and conserve resources. Smart home devices can be used to automate energy use, allowing homeowners to set times where lights and other appliances are turned off or put into standby mode. Smart thermostats can also be used to help regulate temperatures in a home, providing only the heat or air conditioning necessary.
